summary: Frontend-only P0 responsiveness/safe-area/keyboard audit executed on public preview with QA credential login. Multi-viewport smoke (320x568, 360x640, 390x844, 430x932, 844x390, 768x1024) passed for covered routes with no horizontal overflow findings, but two keyboard-simulation regressions remain in chat and moment detail composers at 390x350.

ui_bugs.issue: Send button becomes hidden/unreachable when viewport shrinks to 390x350 (simulated keyboard), while composer scroll remains visible.
Comment send button becomes hidden/unreachable when viewport shrinks to 390x350 (simulated keyboard).

integration_issues.flow: Chat long-press message -> reaction popup reachability check
integration_issues.issue: Could not validate in this run because selected conversation lacked automatable media bubble trigger and text-message bubbles do not expose stable testIDs for reliable long-press automation.

action_items: Fix chat composer layout so chat-send-btn always remains visible/reachable during short-height keyboard scenarios (390x350 and landscape constraints).
Fix moment detail composer layout so comment-send-btn remains visible/reachable in short-height keyboard scenarios.
Add stable testID on regular text message bubble wrappers in chat/[id] to enable deterministic long-press reaction regression automation.
After fixes, retest full viewport matrix and re-run chat/moment keyboard shrink-expand flow.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx keeps composer controls inside a constrained scroll area (chat-composer-scroll maxHeight 70%), which likely contributes to send CTA clipping on short viewport keyboard simulation.

KeyboardAvoidingView web branch is a plain View (no avoid behavior), so web keyboard simulation depends entirely on viewport resizing and local layout ownership; composer rows must self-protect visibility.
Very large screens increase P0 regression risk: room/[id].tsx, chat/[id].tsx, and (tabs)/moments.tsx exceed modular size guidance (>700 lines).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (broad route/viewport smoke passed; 2 critical keyboard-visibility failures remain)

seed_data_creation: Posted QA test messages/comments during validation (chat and moment detail). No auth/payment/backend behavior changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Covered routes: tabs/chats, tabs/connect, tabs/moments, tabs/voice, tabs/profile, chat/[id], connect gender/city sheets, moments filter sheet, moment/[id], moment-compose + topic sheet, room/[id], profile settings, pro/lessons/vocab routes. Overflow detector reported zero actionable overflows across tested viewport matrix (intentional horizontal carousels excluded). Native emulator-only checks (true native safe-area behavior, real keyboard overlays, font-scale 150% OS-level rendering, WebRTC audio transport) were NOT RUN in this web-only environment.
rca_of_issue: RCA 1 (chat): reproduce by opening existing chat, typing message, then shrinking viewport to 390x350; chat-send-btn disappears while chat-composer-scroll remains present. Likely root cause is constrained composer region + short viewport without guaranteed CTA anchoring. RCA 2 (moment detail): open moment detail, type comment, shrink viewport to 390x350; comment-send-btn disappears. Likely root cause is bottom composer layout not preserving send control under short-height keyboard simulation.
